subject: ready-for-life
title: Postsecondary Pathways
essential_question: Which postsecondary pathways are genuinely open to this learner, and what does each require?
topics: college, trade, apprenticeship, military, and direct work
entry requirements and realistic timelines
cost and funding in outline, verified not assumed
fit: setting, structure, and support needs
talking to people on each pathway
building a shortlist that survives scrutiny
performance_task: Compare four postsecondary pathways against this learner's goals, producing a documented shortlist with requirements and deadlines.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Applications, Deadlines, and Documentation
essential_question: What system makes sure nothing is missed when several deadlines overlap?
topics: building a deadline and document tracker
assembling transcripts, records, and references
writing a personal statement in the learner's own voice
proofreading and requesting feedback
submitting and confirming receipt
recovering when a deadline is missed
performance_task: Build and run an application-tracking system across a full cycle of simulated and real deadlines with adult review.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Health and Wellness Self-Management
essential_question: What health responsibilities shift to the learner as they approach adulthood?
topics: making and preparing for an appointment
keeping personal health records privately
describing a concern accurately to a professional
routine care, prevention, and sleep
recognising when to seek help urgently
who to call and how, before it is needed
performance_task: Build a personal health-management plan covering appointments, records, and help-seeking, without disclosing private detail.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Housing and Living Arrangements
essential_question: What does it actually take to live somewhere, and what is a tenant agreeing to?
topics: comparing housing options on total cost and fit
reading a sample lease and naming its obligations
utilities, deposits, and setup sequence
roommates, shared costs, and written agreements
inspection, documentation, and moving out
verifying tenancy rules locally
performance_task: Produce a simulated housing analysis: compare options, read a sample agreement, and build a move-in checklist and budget.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Problem Solving Under Constraint
essential_question: How does a person make a good decision when time, money, and information are all short?
topics: defining the actual problem before solving it
generating more than two options
weighing tradeoffs explicitly
deciding under incomplete information
building a fallback before committing
reviewing a decision after the outcome
performance_task: Work a realistic multi-constraint problem to a defended decision, documenting the tradeoffs and the fallback.

subject: ready-for-life
title: Grade 11 Transition-Planning Capstone
essential_question: Does this learner have a credible, documented plan for what happens after high school?
topics: assembling the year's work into one plan
timeline with verified dates and requirements
naming support needs without shame
contingency planning for the primary pathway
identifying who helps with what
presenting the plan and revising it
performance_task: Produce a documented postsecondary transition plan with pathway, requirements, timeline, funding outline, support needs, and contingencies, reviewed and attested by a guardian.
